rules.ACCOUNT: (?:i (?:cannot|can't|am unable to) (?:log in|sign in|access my account)|my account (?:is|was) locked)

configuration.question: You mentioned account access and a payment issue. Which would you like help with first?
configuration.match: Entire trimmed fragment; all fragments must match, with both ACCOUNT and PAYMENT present.

gate: Preserve supported accepted and correct accepted counts; no increase in incorrect accepted or unsupported suggestions; REVIEW withheld must improve and every authored contrast expectation must match. Offline only.
boundaries: Designed after inspecting the remaining known ACCOUNT/PAYMENT problem-description miss.
Freeze configuration and 30 provisional contrast cases before replay; no revisions from these results.
Replay only prior offline clarification outputs, preserving all existing abstentions.
